invalidity.block_invalid: block.invalid present, or raw records disagree with summary

analysis.ci: paired block bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 20261103, 95% level
invalid_block_rules: B/C/V1N/V1A without sched_ext enabled and ops=eulerpilot at attach
V1A without gate_state=2 recorded in v1-gate.txt
analysis.primary: goodput@SLO gain percent per block, median across blocks

arms_definition.A0: no sched_ext scheduler attached (default kernel scheduler)
arms_definition.B: v2 control plane, mode basic (data-plane base cost)
arms_definition.C: v2 control plane, mode class with expert latency-balanced (the flagship arm)
arms_definition.V1A: same v1 data plane with its gate forced to ACTIVE via its own --gate-set active, i.e. the always-active mode of v1's own report
arms_definition.V1N: v1 data plane (scx_eulerpilot, unmodified sources, commit of D:/code/Ubuntu/EulerPilot HEAD) attached directly, gate left at GATE_NORMAL; v1 Agent/CLI not running

deviations: v1 is built on SP3 with the v2 toolchain (vendored scx headers + kernel-tree static libbpf 1.3) because v1's own recipe injects sources into tools/sched_ext and links the system libbpf 1.2.2, which segfaults at SCX_OPS_LOAD on this kernel; v1 sources are byte-identical to the reference repo (hashes in the evidence file)

v1's Agent and CLI are not run in V1N/V1A: the arms measure the v1 data plane under the same open-loop harness, not v1's closed-loop control plane; v1's own SP4 closed-loop numbers remain non-comparable and are cited only as context
v1 pins its maps and never unlinks them on exit; the harness removes /sys/fs/bpf/eulerpilot only after state=disabled is observed, and records it in the block log
v1 and v2 register the same struct_ops name 'eulerpilot'; arms are distinguished by arm.impl and by the per-block v1-gate.txt / apply.json artifacts, never by ops alone
parameters.frozen_by: experiments/flagship_param_pilot_sp3.sh methodology; workload/slo/online_gate copied verbatim from flagship_params_earms.json so the new arms stay comparable with the frozen flagship arms
parameters.purpose: cross-version sched_ext comparison demanded by the user on 2026-11-03: does the v2 data plane beat the v1 data plane on the contest's own workload, same kernel, same harness, same statistics. R4/R8 baseline remains A0; V1N/V1A are additional arms, not replacements.

slo.metric: goodput_at_slo_rps counted per request from raw-*.bin, never inferred from quantiles

statistics.ci: paired block bootstrap over per-block paired differences
